## Use Classic Console in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Classic Console for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Classic Console', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

## About the Classic Console coding font

A classic console-style font. Classic Console is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Classic Console is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Classic Console FAQ

### Is Classic Console free?

Yes. Classic Console is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Classic Console support ligatures?

No. Classic Console has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Classic Console?

Classic Console is available from Font Squirrel. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
